code.tree_clean_means: git status --porcelain -- pipeline tests PREANALYSIS.md, run in the gizmo folder, printed nothing (untracked files included), so the commit is the code that ran
code.code_identity_means: git rev-parse --verify HEAD:./<path>, run in the gizmo folder, for pipeline, tests and PREANALYSIS.md: the git tree id of pipeline and of tests and the blob id of the plan at the commit. An id depends only on the content under its path, so with tree_clean true the three ids are the code and the plan that ran, whatever else the repository's commit holds. A resumed run is refused unless all three equal the manifest's (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-122: "Compare code identity"); the commit is recorded and not compared

provenance.outcome_file_hash_in_words: frame_fingerprint of the outcome file as the reader returned it, from the door's record
provenance.assembled_inputs_record_fingerprint_mean: sha256 of the assembler's record converted by the writer's rule, with clock readings left out (_seconds_by_source, assembled_at_utc, read_at_utc, seconds, time_utc, written_at_utc); None when no assembler record was given
provenance.order_enforcement: run_outcomes.run and run_outcomes.run_all are not changed and do not check the order; the coordinator in pipeline/analysis/execute_outcomes.py is where the order is enforced

body.plan_section: The second number: per point of load; rule 8.3 and 'A limitation, stated' (sensitivity scenario B, the other end of every dated interval; Joe, 2026-11-19, D-107, adopting R2 of D-106)
body.builder: second_number_scenarios.realise_history (pass_c_exact.realise per state) with scenario_b_settings(...), then points_of, then scenario_frame
body.estimator: second_number_scenarios.run_scenario (second_number.run, the wild cluster bootstrap as built, candidate A)
labels: Sensitivity scenario B, the other end of every dated interval (Joe, D-107; R2 of D-106): each date entry in force that has a convention at the end of its interval its convention does not sit at, every assignment as the inventory has it, each state's factor recomputed. Umatilla enters at 0.0 points at both caps (316 uncapped) and Portland General at 18.9 points. Besides its own kind of question it differs from the primary run in three ways: the two sites with no load history carry load at the early end of each of their questions (bi:852-0 from 2024; bi:837-0's date and the rest of its capacity at 2011), where the primary run leaves out every utility they reach; Oregon's factor is recomputed with those sites carrying load; and its sample differs (Portland General and Umatilla enter at the dose this history gives them, and any unit with load in this history and no 2009-2011 base leaves). It is a sensitivity scenario, not a bound and not necessarily a one-change comparison with the primary analysis.

Quantity side only. The per-state reconstruction check must pass in a state before its scenario work is used there (Joe, D-107).
